name: Brian Kline
source:
In a class below Grendel.

Wanted to see some real-world action and so was teamed up with Grendel and Brian's fellow classmate Kamryn Trujillo

Both were originally afraid of Grendel, but she gained their respect after an action-packed multi-year class assignment.
